title: Remarks on Weyl-type bounds for Steklov eigenvalues
summary: We prove that, for $n\geq 3$, there is no constant $C_n>0$ depending only on $n$ such that the Steklov eigenvalues $σ_k(Ω)$ satisfy $|\partialΩ|^{\frac 1{n-1}}σ_k(Ω)\leq C_nk^{\frac1{n-1}}$ for every smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$ and every $k\geq1 $, providing a negative answer to an open problem posed by Girouard and Polterovich \cite{GiPo}. On the other hand, we prove that there exists a constant $C_n>0$ depending only on $n$ such that $|Ω|^{\frac 1n}σ_k(Ω)\leq C_nk^{\frac1{n-1}}$ for every smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$ and every $k\geq 1$.
